entity: The Altair, Texas recycling site's ~$57M state water-pollution judgment, June 2025 (Skull Creek / Inland Recycling / Polston case)
what_we_add: That the penalty is the biggest state water fine on file after BP's; no source makes the ranking
why: Texas Tribune and the AG report the $60M judgment against Polston's Inland companies for Skull Creek at Altair; the county paper puts civil penalties at $46.5M. Same case and direction, numbers within 25% of our $57.0M.
